title: What Is a Rug Pull? 3 Warning Signs Every Crypto Beginner Should Know
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A rug pull is when a project's creators hype a token, then drain the money and disappear. Sources: KuCoin Learn, Trust Wallet, Built In. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: THE RUG PULL
scenes.narration: Ever heard the term rug pull? It is one of the most common ways beginners lose money in crypto.

scenes.head: WHAT IT MEANS
scenes.narration: Creators hype a new token, people buy it, and then the creators take the money and disappear.

scenes.head: THE CRASH
scenes.narration: When the creators exit, the price can collapse close to zero within minutes, leaving buyers stuck.

scenes.head: 3 WARNING SIGNS
scenes.narration: Warning signs include an anonymous team, lots of hype with no real product, and liquidity that is not locked.

scenes.head: MORE RED FLAGS
scenes.narration: Pressure to buy now, promises of huge gains, and no independent audit are also red flags.

scenes.head: SAFER HABITS
scenes.narration: Safer habits are researching the team, reading independent reviews, and never risking money you need.

scenes.head: EDUCATION, NOT ADVICE
scenes.narration: Hype is not proof. Take your time and check the facts. This is education, not advice.
